title: I just built a free studio/workspace where you can plug in Claude/Codex to make editable, animation-ready 3D assets. It's based on a research paper I co-authored on generating 3D graphics using AI code.
author: mhb_11
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I created an IDE for your 3D projects: [https://studio.nova3d.xyz/](https://studio.nova3d.xyz/)

You can use it to generate animation-ready 3D assets for your games.  
   
Instead of generating monolithic "mesh blobs" like traditional diffusion models, this is a code-native IDE. Your AI agents write structured, part-separated Blender Python code dynamically. The final `.glb` is treated strictly as a compiled artifact. The code is the source of truth.

The video shows a house built directly from a reference image with independent, articulate components.

Core Features:

* PlayCanvas-based Workspace: A split three-pane IDE featuring an agent chat sandbox, an interactive 3D viewport, and a live code mirror side-by-side. 
* Connect your own AI: Connect your own Claude or Codex subs to run generations.
* Live Pivot & Joint Inspector: Test structural articulation constraints (like hinges, doors, and flaps) with real-world degree boundaries in real-time before exporting. 
* Modular Scene Graph: Edit utility pipes, roofs, and building facades as distinct, independent sub-assemblies.

The Origins:

This IDE wasn't built out of nowhere. It's an implementation of my recent research paper: [https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22738](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22738) I'm a co-author. 

Connect your AI agents and use it for free. I'd love to get feedback from game developers and technical artists on how I can improve the workflow or tighter integrate the live code canvas!

No, open source LLMs produced broken or comical results, so I didn't include them yet.  
But you can connect your own Codex or Claude as a Copilot into this, and use it freely.

replies.body: Ah no, it's hosted in the cloud, behind auth currently. It's basically your AI copilot with a full computer at its disposal (like chatGPT for work, but for 3D). So I had create a highly secure harnass alongwith 3D tool use in the backend. I haven't opensourced it yet.

replies.author: mhb_11
replies.body:
I actually did set up an opensource project for this initially: [https://github.com/RareSense/Nova3D](https://github.com/RareSense/Nova3D) But it's grown far beyond that now (for good or for worse). This new thing is now freshly off the oven, and is closed.   
But that github still links to the research paper I co-authored, and to my small discord server in case you want to join.   
Happy testing!
